title: Attosecond Access to the Quantum Noise of Light
summary: Bright squeezed light has entered strong-field atomic physics, creating an immediate need to characterize the quantum field delivered to the target on subcycle timescales. Here we show that attosecond streaking maps the coherent displacement and phase-sensitive covariance of a displaced squeezed field onto distinct harmonics: the mean photoelectron momentum follows an $ω$-periodic shift of the spectral center, whereas the momentum variance exhibits a $2ω$-periodic breathing.
